name: 山斑鳩

iucn.assessmentNote: 全球LC；香港現較少見且局部

illustrationTaxon: Streptopelia orientalis adult, likely winter visitor plumage; main image and diagnostic features

similarSpecies.distinction: 珠頸斑鳩較纖細，尾較長，頸側有佈滿白點的深色斑塊；山斑鳩體較厚、尾較短，頸側為黑白相間條紋，翼上覆羽有顯著栗紅色羽緣。
灰斑鳩頭身大致均勻淡粉灰色，只具黑色半環頸帶，翼上覆羽較素淡；山斑鳩有黑白頸側斑、栗紅羽緣及明顯白色尾端。

featureNotes: 成鳥頸側有獨特黑白斑塊；幼鳥較暗且缺少此斑
肩羽、覆羽黑色羽心具大片栗紅色羽緣，較其他本地斑鳩斑駁
灰色尾羽，上尾羽大片白端；香港斑鳩中具辨識性
成鳥虹膜橙色、喙和腿粉紅；腿色亦見主圖

rangeMap.note: Partial broad range overview based on HKBWS: from central Siberia east of the Urals to Sakhalin and the Kurils, south to eastern Iran, southern India, northern Thailand and northern Vietnam/Laos; occurs widely in China apart from some western/plateau areas. Northern populations are migratory, including northern Xinjiang and Heilongjiang. Highlighted countries are broad-range context only, not nationwide occupancy or exact seasonal/subspecies polygons; Hong Kong status is described separately.

sources.use: Full HKBWS account read (chunks 0–1): Category I; formerly common widespread winter visitor/passage migrant, now relatively uncommon/localized, mainly northwest New Territories; small numbers present year-round. 33–35 cm, bulky short-tailed dove, buffy-pink adult head, black-and-white neck-side patch, strongly variegated black upperparts with extensive rufous fringes, gray tail with broad white tips to upper tail feathers, orange iris and pinkish bill/legs. Young duller and lack the neck patch. Global IUCN LC, stable population trend. Broad Eurasian range and migration described.
sources.evidenceNote: HKBWS says no confirmed nests/eggs/unfledged young in Hong Kong; juveniles in early summer may have been locally reared, so do not state confirmed local breeding.

sources.use: Full HKBWS Spotted Dove account read: common conspicuous resident; 31 cm, slender and longer-tailed, pinkish-grey below, dark grey neck patch with white spots; orange iris, gray bill, dark pink legs. Comparison traits kept distinct from Oriental Turtle Dove's bold black-white patch and rufous-fringed patterned upperparts.

Full HKBWS Eurasian Collared Dove account read: Category IIB local breeding resident in northwest New Territories, pale unmarked pinkish-gray plumage with a black half-collar, relatively long tail; comparison is labelled distinctly, no implication this species is native or widespread in all Hong Kong.
